cards.title: The agenda page

aliases.name: THE AGENDA PAGE
the plate version of the list effect

cards.does: The list takes a plate of its own: a title over rows that divide the whole board, each on its mount with its numeral in a medallion, and each row's catalogued icon stamped on once its sentence has been read.

author.example: {"kind": "agenda", "form": "page", "at": 5.0, "dur": 9.0, "idle": "breath", "title": "WHAT THE BILL IS MADE OF", "rows": [{"text": "A Treasury page", "icon": "prop-icon-us-sovereign-markets-v1"}, {"text": "The rate they pay", "at": 6.6, "icon": "prop-icon-interest-rates-monetary-policy-v2"}, {"text": "Your bill", "at": 8.2, "sub": "$4,500", "icon": "prop-icon-cpi-inflation-basket-v1"}], "target": {"kind": "region", "x0": 0.05, "y0": 0.08, "x1": 0.95, "y1": 0.94}}

phases.name: the title writes
phases.does: the title fades in and the nib draws its rule under it, closing the title's room off the list

phases.name: a row is mounted and numbered
phases.does: the row's plate fades up, the nib draws its medallion and the numeral is written in it
phases.trigger: the row's own `at` (else STEP after the row before)

phases.name: the sentence is written
phases.does: the row's text rises into place, its sub lands beside it as a figure, and the rule draws along the row's bottom edge
phases.trigger: NUM_LEAD after the row's `at`, over ROW_S

phases.name: the icon stamps
phases.does: the row's catalogued cutout falls from PAGE_STAMP_FROM and squashes on impact - never before that row's sentence has been read (E93)
phases.trigger: PAGE_STAMP_LAG after the row's sentence is fully written

phases.name: hold alive
phases.does: every row holds on its own phase of the named idle (E49)

blends.source: Steel and Paper's three-question TEST card (the operator's pointer, E93)
blends.became: the mount, the title and the mark per row

blends.source: E94 the operator's 44 woodblock cutouts, approved for render

cards.title: The axis tag: the named year becomes a pill

aliases.name: Axis tag: the named year / era / span replaces its tick as an accent pill
Drop guides to both axes, a pill at each foot (the x foot)
Vertical event guide under a date capsule

cards.does: On its word the x-axis label the sentence names springs into an accent pill in its place, covering any neighbour it reaches, and on a line page a dotted guide drops from the datum to it, cut round any label. It stands until the page leaves.

author.key: species[] {"kind": "axis_tag", "at", "dur", "x", "label"?, "series"?, "guide"?, "panel"?} on a ledger row; x is a tick or a datum of a line page (a value or a tick's label), or a bars page's bar (its index or its category)

phases.name: the tick becomes the pill
phases.does: the pill springs in about the tick's centre on springPop; the named tick hides once the pill has swallowed it, a neighbour the moment the pill's edge reaches it; the pill's text writes in after

phases.name: the guide drops
phases.does: a dotted rule draws by length from the datum down to the pill's top, never ahead of the drawn ink, cut round the page's own labels (C14); a bars page draws none

phases.name: the tag stands
phases.does: the pill and its guide hold, an annotation now (E99 s91), following the datum on the live scale; a chart_to that replaces the page takes them and the covered labels come back
phases.trigger: POP_S after `at`, until the page's leave (R26-219)

blends.source: Bravos harvest v2 A10 (n=7): the named year replaces its tick as an accent pill (HIS 05:50, JPN 01:16, BOOM)
blends.became: the pill in the tick's place, covering its neighbours

blends.source: tippill's pill (TIPPILL.PAD_X / PAD_Y, pillBox, springPop Mp 0.05)
blends.became: the pill's box and its pop

blends.source: the breakthrough capsule's dotted leader (BREAK.CAP_LEAD_*) and the page's callout capsule (.cpill / .callout)
blends.became: the guide's dash and the pill's accent

options.means: `guide: false`: the pill alone, no drop guide (a bars page never draws one).
`label`: what the pill prints when it is not the tick's own string ('Q2 2000'); a year it prints must be the year it stands on.

cards.title: The bracket page species
cards.does: The hand draws a measured span between two data, the number as its label - on a line, or on a bars page between two bar tops, beside the bars' sides (R26-272); as a brace, one stacked bar braced into its named parts (P70 T5).

phases.name: span draws
phases.does: the hairline (or bar form) draws between the two data

phases.name: ticks pop
phases.does: the end ticks spring open

phases.name: label writes
phases.does: the label writes glyph by glyph (70 %), then the sub (30 %)

phases.name: retract (optional)
phases.does: an undraw after it takes the bracket with the line on the undraw's clock
phases.trigger: a series-less `undraw` or a recast/morph after the bracket

blends.source: Build-on (P47 T2)
Bravos shot 36 bar form

options.means: `form: "brace"` (P70 T5): one stacked bar (`bar`) braced zero to top, cusp toward the label (a figure = the total), a notch per boundary, each part named on its word (`parts_at`) in its ink

cards.title: The level join: a dashed level from one datum to another

aliases.name: Dashed LEVEL rule drawn from one datum to another
Dashed level from one datum to another

cards.does: On its word a dashed rule draws at one datum's level to another datum (or to the value axis), a dashed ring lands at each end, and the gap the page's own numbers make is written beside the far ring, never on the rule.

author.key: species[] {"kind": "level_join", "at", "dur", "from", "to": <datum> | {series, index} | {y}, "label", "series"?, "color"?, "side"?, "dy"?, "panel"?, "keep"?} on a ledger row (a line or bars page)

phases.name: the rule travels
phases.does: the `from` ring draws dash by dash and the dashed rule draws by length at its level toward the far end (min-jerk); the far ring draws as it arrives
phases.trigger: the species' `at`, over RING_A / RULE / RING_B of `dur`

phases.name: the figure writes
phases.does: the gap is written glyph by glyph beside the far ring at the end tags' size, on the first side clear of the rule, the page's labels and the points, inside the plot frame where one is drawn; then the join holds

blends.source: Bravos harvest v2 A9 (5 videos): a dashed level from one datum to another
blends.became: the rule and its two ends

blends.source: the dashed ring's dash law (ringEllipse, ringDashes, RING.DASH / DASH_GAP)
blends.became: the rule's dash rhythm and the two end rings

blends.source: the bracket's hand (Kalam, glyph by glyph, the series' ink)

options.means: `to: <index>` another datum of the series, `{series, index}` a datum of another series in the same unit, `{y}` the value axis at `from`'s own level (the axis form).
`side: right|left|above|below` (+ `dy`, lines): the author's place for the figure, honoured; a place on the rule is a WARN with its numbers (E99 s106).

doctrine: C14 (the harvest v2 conflict: the label never on the rule)

cards.title: The lens: a magnifier glass travels a stretch of the line

aliases.name: Magnifier lens over the chart
Magnifier lens (don't: invent zoomed values)

cards.does: On its word a magnifier glass rises onto a drawn line, travels the named stretch and leaves; inside its ring the page's own data are redrawn at the row's zoom - every vertex a datum, no value invented.

author.key: species[] {"kind": "lens", "at", "dur", "from": <datum>, "to"?: <datum>, "series"?, "zoom"?: 1..4} on a ledger LINE row (dense-line)

phases.name: the glass rises
phases.does: the glass rises onto its first stand from RISE_K radii below, fading in
phases.trigger: the species' `at`, over IN_S (at most EDGE_MAX of `dur`)

phases.name: the glass travels
phases.does: its centre walks the stretch from -> to by length on the min-jerk clock (the lit stretch's law); inside the ring the page's own data, magnified by `zoom` about the centre
phases.trigger: between the rise and the leave

phases.name: the glass leaves
phases.does: it slides EXIT_K radii to the right and fades out by the word's end

blends.source: Bravos harvest v2 A57 (STK 9:16-9:18, BOOM 06:28): a magnifier glass sweeps a stretch of the chart
blends.became: the glass, its look (ring R 0.0676 W, stroke 0.127 R, crimson handle) and its rise - travel - leave

blends.source: the lit stretch's travel law (litStretchPts, litCut, litDrawnX)
blends.became: the glass's stand on the line and the pen's edge inside it

options.means: `to: <index>`: the far datum of the stretch the glass travels; absent, it stands on `from`.
`zoom: 1..4`: the magnification inside the ring, the author's (default 1 - Bravos's glass, measured, magnifies nothing).

cards.title: The lit stretch: a light travels the line

aliases.name: A stretch relights
Comet retrace over its own ghost
a highlight that TRAVELS along a length

cards.does: On its word a light runs along one stretch of a drawn line, from one datum to another, and holds there lit; the rest of the line keeps its ink. It moves because it travels (E99 s99); a comet head may ride its leading edge.

author.key: species[] {"kind": "lit_stretch", "at", "dur", "from", "to", "series"?, "color"?, "comet"?} on a ledger row; from/to are two datum indices or two 0..1 x-fractions

phases.name: the light travels
phases.does: the lit stretch grows from `from` toward `to` by arc length on the min-jerk clock, the comet head at its leading edge, never ahead of the drawn ink

phases.name: the light holds
phases.does: the whole stretch stands lit, an annotation now (E99 s91); the comet head fades; an undraw or a replacing chart_to takes it on its own clock
phases.trigger: TRAVEL of `dur` after `at`; the head over HEAD_OUT_S

blends.source: Bravos harvest v2 A11 (8 of 9 videos): a stretch relights, the glow travels down one segment
the span's edge law (spanEdgeX)
R26-228 the electric (lpBloom's halo, the relight's sunflower)

options.means: `comet: true`: a bright head with a halo rides the light's leading edge (A13) and fades once it lands.

cards.title: The membership stack: a member's tile lands on its word
cards.does: A bar of ONE value divided into EQUAL tiles naming who is in it (a catalogued logo, else the name), its total written and 'each tile = one <noun>' beside it; a tile lands on its member's word.

author.key: species[] {"kind": "member", "at", "dur" 0.2-1.2, "tile": i | [i, ...] | "all", "bar"?, "light"?} on a ledger row whose bars page carries `members` on a bar (ledger_page: `members: [{name, logo?, short?}]`, `member_noun`)

lives.note: lpMemberBuild divides each membership bar into equal tiles; lpMemberPaint lands them (the build's cascade or each word) on the badge spring and lights one - a pure function of t

cards.title: Panels and focus on a word (quad, grow, recede)

aliases.name: one grows up to cover the page while the others blur and recede
the ledger page draws PANELS

cards.does: A `panels` page (2-4 charts, line or bars, one scale per unit, E79) changes focus on a word: a layout (row, stack, quad, free) and a role per panel (active, receded, hidden), in one move; receded panels scale back, dim, blur, stay.

author.key: species[] {"kind": "panel_focus", "at", "dur", "layout": "row|stack|quad|free", "roles" | "active" | "hidden", "recede"?: {"scale", "dim", "blur"}, "region"?, "boxes"?} on a page built from a `panels` object; other species take `panel: <i>`; a panel is {sub, series} (line, the default) or {sub, builder: "bars", unit, bars: [{label, value | [lo, hi]}]} (P69 T8d); on a bars panel a figure, chart_to compare|park and a pointing species (callout, ring: target.panel) land, and build_to / undraw / bracket / spread / span / lit_stretch are refused by name; a bars panel is 16:9 only

phases.name: the receded soften first
phases.does: panels leaving focus dim and blur on their own clock, done by half the move, so the growing panel reads cleanly over them

phases.name: the boxes move
phases.does: every panel's box moves to its cell by one translate plus uniform scale; a box of another aspect is the chart re-laid out at that width, words at their size - a lone panel spans the plot region

phases.name: a bars panel holds its bars
phases.does: a bars panel shown larger than its home is rebuilt at that scale, so its bars stay at most 196 px on the stage while its words grow with the box (E99 s96)
phases.trigger: every frame of the move, by the pose's scale

phases.name: the focused sharpen
phases.does: a panel coming forward sharpens in the second half of the move; a receded panel holds its species and stays on the page

blends.source: the verdict stack's recede to the mosaic
the park's box-to-box move

options.means: Layout: a 2x2 grid over the plot region.
Layout: a box per panel (stage fractions); the grown state.
`builder: bars` - a panel drawn by the bars builder: its bars (at most 196 px), each value on its bar with its unit, the zero line.
A bar `value: [lo, hi]` - drawn to its near end, a lighter dashed band to the far end, the range printed as stated ("+55–60%"), never a midpoint.

lives.note: buildLedgerPanels, lpPanelPoses (pure in t); ledger_page.panel_layout; build_scene_timeline_f.panel_focus_state

cards.title: Solo: the named one keeps its ink

aliases.name: On-word isolate (lines)
On-word isolate (bars)
peers ghost, one series stays lit
one bar ignites, the rest dim

cards.does: On its word every other series of a line page, or every other bar of a bars page, mutes to E67's dim (0.45) and the one the sentence names keeps its ink; the key, axes and names stay. `unsolo` restores.

author.key: species[] {"kind": "solo", "at", "dur" 0.2-1.5, "series": i | "bar": i} on a ledger line or bars row (2+ series or bars; not a panels, extruded or membership page); {"kind": "unsolo", "at", "dur"} restores

phases.name: the others mute
phases.does: every other series' stroke, lead point and end tag - or every other bar, its band and its value - eases to DIM on min-jerk; the named one keeps its ink, and a light on a muted series mutes with it
phases.trigger: the species' `at`, over its `dur` (a second solo hands over from where the first left each mark)

phases.name: the isolate holds
phases.does: the page stands with one mark at full ink and the rest at DIM - standing ink now, no further event
phases.trigger: the end of the mute's `dur`, until an unsolo or a verb that replaces the page

phases.name: unsolo restores
phases.does: every muted mark eases back to its ink; at full ink the solo's attribute is removed, the page as it was
phases.trigger: an `unsolo`'s `at` over its `dur`, or a recast / morph / remake at or after the first solo

blends.source: Bravos harvest v2 A12 (8 of 9 videos): peers ghost, one series stays lit (JPN 05:23.5 frame_0008)
Bravos harvest v2 A49: one bar ignites, the rest dim (CHN t530, unlit at 0.38x)
E67's muted history, the series' own hue at 0.45 (buildLedgerLine, LP_MUTED; T45's member light)
the lit stretch's leave (a recast, morph or remake takes it)
blends.became: the release on a verb that replaces the page

options.means: `{"kind": "unsolo", "at", "dur"}`: every muted series or bar eases back to its ink on the word; a recast, morph or remake after the solo releases it the same way.
